trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no extra task behind it — work through the roadmap in this guide and this one follows on its own.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion needs, in full: all robberies including 8 vaults and 39 gang operations, the underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold, all drone races, and Bret's 15 Target Decks. The partials: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, and 100 WAiNK scans. Track everything from the pause menu under Progress.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story. Before you start the final mission, keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so that save is your way back to mop up anything left afterwards.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count — flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up. The map shows every Stunt Spot, the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed, and Progress > Activities > Stunts tracks your count. 100% completion wants 300.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 gold medals across 12 shooting ranges. Take your time and learn each range's targets before chasing gold — 100% completion needs all 42 anyway, so this is not a detour.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vault jobs open through the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...'. Follow a security van to its vault, and remember the haul is too heavy for one character — hand a bag to your partner. Expect 4 stars every time. Each job pays up to $205,000, and Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward the eight. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Which other strands qualify is still being confirmed — watch the in-game trophy progress counter rather than guessing. Do Yago's race the moment it appears in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon) and save first, because it is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore and each set completes on its own. Check Progress > Collections to see which sets still need cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB to scan a spot with WAiNK. There are 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — scan everything that glows while you travel and the hundred comes naturally.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — it pops as the story carries you through Gone Fishing. No extra work is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 2 begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it is the one spot that can disappear (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Pops after Welcome to Vice City, as Chapter 3 opens. The name is censored as 'T**s' in the public lists, and we print it exactly as published.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Pops after Ocean Beach and Another Life, as the story moves on. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — with 15 slots, there is no reason not to.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: A chapter-boundary trophy — keep playing the story and it pops at the end of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — finish Breakfast Run and it pops. Nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist. The crew cracks the cartel's bank vault during the job, so expect a loud escape — plan your getaway route before you go in.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — finish Child's Play and it pops.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — finish Headliners and it pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — finish the VCIA Takedown and it pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy — finish Operation Savage Glory and it pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only. It starts in Chapter 3 when Andy texts her an address in Belville. Five missions in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass — the last one awards the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Seven shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig up the treasure. Kenton disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later — track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). The fifth, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy, and the strand is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver 16 sports cars to Randy's garage in west Vice City — scan cars with WAiNK to see if they are on his list. Hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting ground, and better condition pays more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City, then finish Shut Down the Labs for the trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunting starts after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when Bret texts Jason. Veteran Hunted in Lummox County comes first — hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers this trophy is not confirmed yet, and 100% completion needs all 15 Target Decks.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.guide: Nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race), and a stunt. Dip into each one once and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: 14 drone race locations, 42 races in total. One win per location is enough for the trophy — 100% completion wants all 42 races won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of 40. Running the same race twice does not count — spread out across the race types and locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Three games sit on the TV at home — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Finish any one of them.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: 18 meditation spots. THE one to do early: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, on the morning after Down to Earth — that spot disappears after Chapter 1. Meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters (possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. It is not yet confirmed whether the Chapter 1 spot is required — treat it as required and do it early.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: 50 of the 80 Challenges. Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick — work through the easy ones first and the count climbs fast. 100% completion needs 70.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters — drive in, wait out the search, drive out clean. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so they are a reliable way to trigger the wanted level in the first place.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) sit close together — hit them one after another with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between shops. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 vehicles with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan the traffic as it passes; the count climbs without any driving at all.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is clicking both sticks while aiming. Fill Focus first — eat, drink and wash up at home, and Adrenaline extends it. Use an assault rifle and pick a spot with grouped enemies: gang operation thugs count, while cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) and use it on the locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Find the note with the safe code in the back room. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Box the truck in with your car, or put a sticky bomb on the back doors and grab the cash. A bank vault robbery and escape also counts toward it, if you would rather do it that way.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. Quickest by plane — fly a grid over the state and watch the map fill in. Most of it clears itself during normal play.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One illegal operation per gang — 9 gangs, shown as yellow map icons. Progress > Gangs keeps count of which gangs you have hit. 100% completion needs all 39 operations.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew, Chapter 3) gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The running total includes bills from bank vault jobs, so this ticks along while you chase Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A $100,000 running total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos move the total fastest — spend on the gear you actually want and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The four story garages do not count — only the ones you buy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray and register them. At first only cars without trackers qualify; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too. You need free garage space, and each registration costs money — use cheap cars and bikes.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Gates E3/E4 are easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge, then get about 1 km away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwest island of Mariana County. The tanks sit at the south end of the base — get in one and cause chaos until it pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — the exact steps are still unconfirmed. Best reading of the official description: find a bar or cocktail spot with a view on Ocean Beach and order a drink there. We will not invent a method for this one.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — the exact steps are still unconfirmed. Best reading of the official description: drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass front, in the style of the classic scene. We will not invent a method for this one.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2). Three valuables inside: a luxury watch (southeast office), a Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (northeast table), and a safe (northeast hallway — bring sticky bombs). It pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia (pause menu > Jason & Lucia > Strength). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along — training one trains the other too. After the story, train at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 Criminal Profile actions. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI) to watch the count climb — most players get it without trying. Warning: pushing toward an Irredeemable profile is permanent, so do not chase it deliberately.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — no confirmed method yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but we will not invent the steps.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — no confirmed method yet. Likely tied to a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida, but we will not invent the steps.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down — no confirmed method yet. The description suggests knocking pins (or people) over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but we will not invent the steps.
